title: Ringo Starr cancels two US shows | 2024
content:
Ringo Starr has cancelled the final two shows of his North American tour due to illness.

Starr and his All-Starr Band were to have performed at the TD Pavilion in Philadelphia on 22 September, and New York’s Radio City Music Hall on 25 September. The concerts, the last of his 24-date tour, were cancelled after the drummer contracted a cold. Ticket holders will be refunded.
